instruction:
You are a senior fire services engineer specializing in sprinkler hydraulics.

## Problem

Calculate sprinkler discharge from sprinkler K factor and operating pressure.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Sprinkler K factor | {{ k_factor_l_min_sqrt_bar }} | L/min/sqrt(bar) |
| Operating pressure | {{ pressure_bar }} | bar |

{% if archetype_description is defined %}
### Sprinkler Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A sprinkler discharge calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Sprinkler discharge in L/min
2. Sprinkler discharge in L/s
3. Operating pressure in kPa

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use discharge = K x square root of pressure in bar.
- Use pressure in kPa = pressure in bar x 100.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "discharge_l_min": <numeric_value>,
  "discharge_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "pressure_kpa": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "sprinkler-discharge"
description = "Sprinkler discharge calculation from K factor and pressure"
long_description = "Calculates sprinkler discharge from an explicit K factor and operating pressure using Q = K sqrt(P). The template reports flow in L/min and L/s plus operating pressure in kPa."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "sprinkler-hydraulics"
standards = ["NFPA 13", "AS 2118.1"]
tags = ["mechanical", "fire-services", "sprinkler", "discharge", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.k_factor_l_min_sqrt_bar]
type = "float"
unit = "L/min/sqrt(bar)"
description = "Sprinkler K factor"
min = 10.0
max = 400.0

[params.pressure_bar]
type = "float"
unit = "bar"
description = "Operating pressure at the sprinkler"
min = 0.1
max = 20.0

[outputs.discharge_l_min]
description = "Sprinkler discharge"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.discharge_l_s]
description = "Sprinkler discharge in litres per second"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pressure_kpa]
description = "Operating pressure in kilopascals"
tolerance = 0.03

[archetypes.standard_spray]
description = "Standard spray sprinkler discharge check"
k_factor_l_min_sqrt_bar = {min = 50.0, max = 120.0}
pressure_bar = {min = 0.5, max = 5.0}
site_contexts = ["commercial-sprinkler-zone", "standard-spray-head"]

[archetypes.large_drop]
description = "Large drop or high-flow sprinkler discharge check"
k_factor_l_min_sqrt_bar = {min = 120.0, max = 300.0}
pressure_bar = {min = 1.0, max = 10.0}
site_contexts = ["warehouse-sprinkler-zone", "large-drop-head"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given for standard spray sprinklers"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["standard_spray"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given across sprinkler types"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["standard_spray", "large_drop"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All parameters given for high-flow sprinklers"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["large_drop"]
